text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, Sakura Chiyono O contacted me
to let me know she would be late for training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That said, there were countless things I could do on my own.
As I was getting everything ready before she arrived...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa~~!
Maruzen-san is running--!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, so cool~!
...Wait, isn't it a bit less impactful than it used to be?
I feel like I remembered it being way more awesome...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Silly, it's been a while since I last ran.
Of course I'm not going to give it my all right away.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Isn't she running at about seventy percent just to warm up first?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I see!
I want to see Maruzen-san go all out real soon~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm, nope, that's not quite it~

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Is my absolute best right now... really worth so little in your eyes?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, you're right.
I'm not the kind of Umamusume to stop here.
If I'm the one that girl looked up to—"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I—I have to scrape the rust off these gears...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, sorry I'm late!
I'm ready for today's training!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, isn't it super crowded around here today?!
Did something happen?"
choice_data_list: Maruzensky was just running there a moment ago...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ehh~?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Why didn't you tell me...!
I wanted to see it too...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O began shivering like a tiny puppy.
I felt like it had been a while since I last saw her like that.
choice_data_list: You really do look up to Maruzensky, don't you?
You really do look up to Maruzensky, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Of course. Otherwise,
I don't think I would try to pursue it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Because she's the one who gave a future to me,
back when I thought I was just ordinary and could never amount to anything.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: And as for Trainer-san...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
You're the person who supports who I am today.
So, Happy Valentine's Day. Yes.
choice_data_list: Is getting this ready why you were running late...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Ah!?
No, um...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
About the chocolate just now, it's more that
I'd like you to accept it without worrying
about what happened earlier...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
B-But the awkwardness won't just go away, will it...?
Hmmmmm~...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Then, instead!
In exchange for accepting this,
may I ask you for one favor?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "I would love it if you could tell me... what Maruzen-san's running was like."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
How about... we consider this
your return gift, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! But you have to teach me
a whuuuump-load, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I decided to describe Maruzensky's running,
which we had just seen, to Sakura Chiyono O
as vividly as possible.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I decided to describe Maruzensky's running,
which we had just seen, to Sakura Chiyono O
as vividly as possible.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Good work today.
That wraps up today's training, doesn't it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you again tomorrow, then!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just as I was about to wave to Sakura Chiyono O, I remembered the chocolate in my pocket that she had given me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?
choice_data_list: Can I make it up to you with one more thing?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Mmph... *gulp*!
Phew~, delicious~.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Still, are you sure it was okay for you to treat me to all this?
choice_data_list: I'm totally fine with this much.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Getting a meat bun in return for chocolate.
I'm quite lucky, aren't I~?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Phew, thanks for the meal.
Aha, looks like we finished eating
at the exact same time, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I suppose so...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Then, why don't we have one more?
We can just split the next one in half.
choice_data_list: Don't say that—I'll treat you to a whole one.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
!! Really?! Are you sure?!
Yaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Then let's go with chocolate buns next!
To give it that Valentine's vibe~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O was about to dash off toward the convenience store—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Did it break!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she lurched forward, about to fall flat on her face,
I grabbed her shoulder and pulled her back.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry...
My left leg got caught on my right leg...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Ugh, to make such an unprecedented blunder
in front of you, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Haaah~... But...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Being helped like that makes you look even cooler than usual...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, and we even got to see
Trainer's good side.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Okaay.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I kept a close watch over Sakura Chiyono O
so she wouldn't trip anymore on our way back to the academy.
